summary: Route scout workbook for VD-98-076, the DT06 aminopyridine campaign for Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS. It compares the convergent route with side-chain installation moved earlier against the first route, records intermediate recoveries and final release purity, and lists the 32 analogues delivered for the matched-pair biology study.

properties.title: VD-98-076 DT06 route scout and delivery workbook

sheets.name: Summary
rows: Side-chain installation moves ahead of the ring coupling. Recovery of the coupled intermediate improved and gave enough material for the matched-pair study.
Two members with the morpholine side chain need a second purification. Mainly a volume problem, not a purity one.

sheets.name: Route scout
rows: Ring coupling first, side chain installed last
Original route. Final coupling needed the amine in excess and gave poor recovery on the larger runs.
Side chain installed on the pyridine before ring coupling
Recovery of the coupled intermediate higher on every run. Cleaner crude for the release HPLC.
As route 2, with the acetamide added as the last step
Tried on the first analogue set only. Not carried forward because of a regioselectivity problem.
Recoveries recorded per run in the lab notebook, not repeated here. Route 2 is the only one used for the delivery lots.

sheets.name: Release checks
rows: Identity by 1H NMR and LCMS. Purity by HPLC, UV area % at 254 nm, against the release specification in the study plan.
Area % from the HPLC trace is the number reported to Drelvessa. Mass balance is not claimed.

rows.v: Analogues delivered to Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS for the matched-pair biology study

rows: Yield is isolated. Purity is HPLC area % at 254 nm. Amounts are delivered mg per compound.
